description: Reads what can be configured on one webinar and what stands there right now: every editable settings group with each field, its type and its current value, plus the core fields (type, status, date, time, timezone, room phase). `group` narrows it to the catalogue of one area (for example the mail slots, the CTA slots or the schedule blocks) instead of the stored values. Read-only, it changes nothing. Use it when the host asks what a setting is called, what it is set to, or which values are allowed before something is changed. Do not use it for the emails themselves (that is wi_get_webinar_emails) or the colours (that is wi_get_webinar_colors). Data comes only from the WordPress site this chat is connected to, the site the host approved, never from another site. Without a connected site the answer says what is missing and how to connect: no numbers and no example numbers.

group.description: Optional: read the catalogue of ONE area instead of the stored values, e.g. mails, ctas, schedule, replay, qa, design.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id. Needed for the stored values; leave it out when you only want the catalogue of a group.

name: wi_get_webinar_settings
title: Read the settings of a webinar
